missing.what_was_said: Kress reported Q1 non-GAAP gross margin of 61%, including a $4.5 billion H20 inventory and purchase-obligation charge. Excluding that charge, non-GAAP gross margin would have been 71.3%. The late-year mid-70s target remained unchanged despite this interim setback.

Alongside the statement that the goal had been achieved, Kress reported Q3 gross margins of 73.4% GAAP and 73.6% non-GAAP, and forecast Q4 margins of 74.8% and 75.0%, respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points. This distinguishes the achievement language in S4 from the quarterly results then reported.

missing.what_was_said: Colette Kress said, “We began production shipments of GB300 in Q2.” This refers to fiscal Q2 FY2026, not calendar Q2.

Despite full production being underway, Kress still said, “We expect widespread market availability in the second half of the year.” This distinguishes production progress from completed market availability.

Kress reported a seamless transition to GB300, with production shipments to major cloud service providers, hyperscalers and GPU clouds already driving their growth. This confirms commercial delivery within the promised second-half window.
